newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: RESEARCH ALERT - Keumkang lowered to "hold".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Keumkang lowered to "hold".

text.p: ING-Baring Securities said on Friday it had revised downward its forecasts for Keumkang Development Inc's recurring profits for 1997 and 1998, citing a poor performance during the spring bargain sale period.
At the same time, the brokerage house has downgraded its recommendation on the retail chain operator to "hold" from "buy", ING-Baring said in a report.

Keumkang's most prominent store, located in the affluent Seoul district of Apkujong, generates 43 percent of total sales. Sales year-on-year dropped five percent during the spring bargain sale period, the report said.
Accordingly, the brokerage said it had changed its stance on Keumkang to negative for the time being.
ING-Baring had cut its forecasts for Keumkang's recurring profit to 21.3 billion won for 1997 and 22.2 billion won for 1998, respectively, from 22.9 billion and 35.3 billion.
Keumkang, a unit of the Hyundai Group, operates Hyundai Department Store chains.
